evaluation_summary.common_critical_limitation_across_all_ge: All general image-to-3D neural models (TRELLIS, Hunyuan3D, SF3D, TripoSR, InstantMesh, CRM, Unique3D, LGM) reconstruct solid, watertight 3D volumes. They cap anatomical clothing openings (neck collar, sleeve cuffs, waistband, hem) with solid geometry, preventing avatar bodies from wearing the garment without destructive post-hoc Boolean cutting. Furthermore, none of them output skeletal joint skinning weights (ARA rig compatibility).

primary_remote_candidate.target_environment: Remote NVIDIA A10G Cloud Worker (Modal / RunPod)
primary_remote_candidate.justification: Superior visual fidelity for fabric folds and high-resolution textures when deployed on dedicated cloud CUDA instances.

primary_local_production_engine.target_environment: Local Apple Silicon MPS / CPU Fallback
primary_local_production_engine.justification: Guarantees wearable open boundaries (neck, hem, cuffs), provides native ARA skeletal skinning weights, dynamically carves cross-sections to match segmented photo silhouettes, and runs in sub-50ms on Apple Silicon MPS.

microsoft_trellis.name: TRELLIS
microsoft_trellis.architecture: Structured Triplane + Sparse 3D Gaussians (3DGS) + Flow Matching Transformer
microsoft_trellis.output_representation: Dual format: 3D Gaussian Splats (.ply) and Textured Mesh (.glb)
microsoft_trellis.mps_blocker_reason: Relies on custom CUDA C++ kernels (diff-gaussian-rasterization) that fail to compile under Metal
microsoft_trellis.hidden_surface_inference: Flow-matching transformer hallucinates plausible rear geometry from learned prior
microsoft_trellis.commercial_license: COMMUNITY_RESTRICTED (Code: MIT; Weights: Microsoft Research Non-Commercial)
strengths: Industry-leading micro-wrinkle and fabric fold fidelity
limitations_for_clothing: Generates watertight solid blob; neck, cuffs, and waist are capped solid
Requires boolean mesh subtraction to create wearable body openings
Non-commercial weight license limits unencumbered commercial monetization

tencent_hunyuan3d_v2.name: Hunyuan3D 2.0
tencent_hunyuan3d_v2.architecture: High-Resolution Diffusion Transformer (DiT) + 3D Shape VAE + Multi-view Texture Diffusion
tencent_hunyuan3d_v2.mps_blocker_reason: Total parameter footprint exceeds unified memory; CUDA extensions required
tencent_hunyuan3d_v2.hidden_surface_inference: Multi-view diffusion generates 6 orthogonal views before 3D fusion
tencent_hunyuan3d_v2.commercial_license: COMMUNITY_RESTRICTED (Tencent Community License with user threshold constraints)
strengths: Outstanding geometric detail and natural drape representation
Clean manifold mesh extraction with normal map baking
limitations_for_clothing: Prohibitive latency (45-90s per asset) unsuitable for live interactive try-on
Solid watertight volume requires carving
Extreme VRAM requirement (>24GB)

stability_sf3d.name: Stable Fast 3D (SF3D)
stability_sf3d.architecture: Feed-forward Triplane Predictor + Fast UV Unwrapper + Material Delighting Transformer
stability_sf3d.output_representation: Textured Mesh (.glb) with Normal & Roughness maps
stability_sf3d.mps_blocker_reason: Requires nvdiffrast and custom CUDA rasterizers for fast UV unwrapping
stability_sf3d.hidden_surface_inference: Triplane transformer extrapolates rear surface based on object symmetry prior
strengths: Sub-1.5s GPU inference latency enables real-time turnaround
Native GLB export with baked PBR materials
limitations_for_clothing: Solid mesh without wearable cavities
Collapses sharp collars and pocket flaps into smooth geometry

triposr.name: TripoSR
triposr.architecture: Large Reconstruction Model (LRM) Transformer + Triplane NeRF + Marching Cubes
triposr.mps_blocker_reason: Can execute via PyTorch CPU/MPS fallback (18-28s on M2), but lacks UVs
triposr.hidden_surface_inference: NeRF triplane predicts density and color in occluded regions
limitations_for_clothing: Coarse blobby geometry lacking seam or cuff demarcation
Does not generate UV unwrapped textures out-of-the-box (vertex colors only)
Solid watertight volume

instantmesh.name: InstantMesh
instantmesh.architecture: Zero123++ Multi-view Diffusion + Large Gaussian Model (LGM) + FlexiCubes Extraction
instantmesh.mps_blocker_reason: FlexiCubes C++ extensions compile only on CUDA
strengths: Decent texture sharpness from multi-view synthesis
limitations_for_clothing: FlexiCubes produces non-manifold boundary artifacts on thin garment hems
Solid volume requiring post-carving

crm.name: CRM (Convolutional Reconstruction Model)
crm.architecture: Multi-view Convolutional Feature Mapping + Orthogonal Projection + FlexiCubes
limitations_for_clothing: Prone to webbing between sleeves and torso
Watertight solid mesh

unique3d.name: Unique3D
unique3d.architecture: Multi-view Normal & Color Diffusion + Normal-Guided Mesh Reconstruction (IS-Mesh)
unique3d.mps_blocker_reason: IS-mesh normal deformation requires CUDA kernels
unique3d.hidden_surface_inference: Normal maps generated for 4 orthogonal views
limitations_for_clothing: Strict non-commercial license blocks production usage
High latency (30s+)
Watertight mesh

lgm.name: LGM (Large Gaussian Model)
lgm.architecture: Multi-view Asymmetric UNet + Direct 3D Gaussian Splatting Prediction
lgm.mps_blocker_reason: CUDA rasterizer required for gaussian splat rendering
limitations_for_clothing: Outputs point cloud / Gaussian splats, NOT an animatable polygonal mesh
Cannot be skinned to skeletal joints for ARA avatar virtual try-on
Cannot compute cloth physics or vertex collisions
